exposure: 0.375% ropivacaine with normal saline in ultrasound-guided transversusabdominis plane (TAP) block
0.375% ropivacaine with 0.5 mcg/kg dexmedetomidine in ultrasound-guided transversusabdominis plane (TAP) block
outcome: Visual analog scale (VAS) score for pain at 6 hours
cohort: 80 patients undergoing lower segment caesarean section were included in this study.
finding: The addition of dexmedetomidine to ropivacaine in a TAP block significantly prolonged the duration of analgesia, provided better pain control at 6 hours, and reduced the requirement for rescue analgesia in patients undergoing lower segment caesarean section.
